_meta.description: Frequent-flyer programs popular with travellers flying out of India. Values are illustrative and change frequently — always confirm on the airline's own site before transferring.

airlines.name: Singapore Airlines
airlines.highlight: Excellent premium-cabin availability and Saver award sweet spots to SE Asia and beyond.

airlines.name: Qatar Airways
airlines.highlight: Qsuite business class to Europe and the Americas via Doha; strong Avios value.

airlines.name: British Airways
airlines.highlight: Short-haul Avios redemptions and reward-flight savers into London.

airlines.name: Etihad Airways
airlines.highlight: Frequent transfer-bonus promotions and easy Gulf connections.

airlines.name: Air France–KLM
airlines.highlight: Monthly Promo Rewards can cut European award costs by up to 50%.

airlines.name: Emirates
airlines.highlight: Dense network from every Indian metro; reliable cash-plus-miles options.

airlines.name: Air India
airlines.highlight: Best for domestic India hops and non-stop long-haul to the US and Europe.

airlines.name: Turkish Airlines
airlines.highlight: Star Alliance partner awards to Europe and North America at low mileage.
